Ethan - AE: Quick sync on NorthStar deal — customer sent perf profile and wants minimal reserved GPUs + predictable billing. They expect intermittent 10‑15m chat spikes up to 900 qps. Steady text ~25 qps.
Priya (Presales): Key asks: 99th pct latency targets: text <350ms, chat <900ms. Security: no spot for PHI, prefer Private. Finance asks for soft cap on burst charges.
Marco Ops: Reality check: chat avg token ~220, text ~35. Stateful chat uses KV per session so warmup matters. For that spike you need preheated KV or heavy reserved capacity.
Ethan - AE: Customer insists on starting small (1–2 reserved) and proving it. Is there a safe play?
Priya (Presales): Safe play = reserve for steady text + small chat cushion, plus an autoscale + burst-credit policy. Recommend 3 reserved A100‑equiv quantized GPUs as a compromise.
Marco Ops: Autoscale proposal: 
```
{"policy":"scale_add:1","trigger":"gpu_util>65%:3m","scale_add_on_peak":"+2","burst_limit":"40%:25m"}
```
This gives gradual scaling and a short burst window.
Claire Sec: For Private deployment we can do KMS + audit logs. No PHI-specific blocker but need contract for retention. We cannot use cross‑AZ spot for PHI — must be consented.
BillingBot: Note on billing: reserved monthly covers baseline. Burst credit usage billed hourly at reduced rate. We can provide a monthly overage cap with surcharge; needs AE signoff.
Priya (Presales): Ops runbook snippet to avoid tail latency:
```
# preheat loop (pseudo)
for i in 1..150:
  POST /chat {session: "preheat-i", prompt: "<seed>"}
# ensures KV spread across reserved GPUs
```
Ethan - AE: Action items: Priya produce 2 quote variants (3x reserved + cap, and 1x reserved + higher cap) by EOD. Marco deliver autoscale JSON + preheat steps. Claire prepare security appendix for contract. BillingBot will draft cap pricing.
Marco Ops: One caveat — if they insist on 1 reserved only, we must warn about degraded chat SLOs and recommend aggressive preheat + app-side retry/quality fallback.
Ethan - AE: I'll flag that in the quote. Thanks team :thumbsup:
BillingBot: Ticket created: presales/1747123456 — NorthStar capacity & billing options.
